comparison: every candidate is RUN for real on every mock query (12 workers, CPUs 0-11); branch-aware virtual replay from the reference is a cross-check only (prefix-equivalence must hold exactly on every query, else virtual results are not used)
event: V_place(S_hyp, o, d; PI_PLACE_3D) conditional on a certified post-grasp state of o: lift -> carry -> lower -> release -> retreat -> settle; no free move, hover, approach, closure test, pick, sequencing, ready return or target-goal test

gates.accounting: 0 unaccounted modes and 0 unaccounted branches on every query

coverage.K4_NONE: COVERAGE_BLOCKED (not in the pinned source / not validated)

determinism: adaptive_v1 run A vs run B: 0 canonical mismatches
serial subset vs run A: 0 mismatches
SIGKILL + resume vs run A: 0 mismatches
virtual (from reference_v2) vs real for every candidate: 0 mismatches or the virtual path is reported unusable

runtime.forecast: live snapshot roster x stratum CPU (K x depth x band, backed off) with root-lineage bootstrap (2000)

semantics: every label 1 has a stored witness with all verify gates
no unlabeled status stored with label 0
branch fixtures: v1 rejects / v2 rescues (natural if found, else injected + labelled synthetic)
gates.source_integrity: pinned source (yadu/dataset-3d@8032ad0b) re-hash: 0 changes; v1 artifacts unchanged
gates.split_leakage: 0 val/test mock roots; holdout lineages disjoint from every V1-touched lineage; 0 cross-split derived layouts
storage: every unit JSON + NPZ re-validates (sha256 + witness re-hash)
fresh-process replay re-verifies 100% of stored positives (all runs)

labels.0: NEG_CERTIFIED_GEOMETRY (scope: 32 poses x <= 4 source IK candidates x the 2-D footprint carry model) | NEG_UNDER_POLICY (BOUNDED_SEARCH / EXECUTION / DETERMINISTIC_PLAN, with its work scope)
labels.1: a scheduled unit's eligible branch passes every placement3d.verify gate (MuJoCo-executed)
labels.unlabeled: static ineligible, NO_VALID_POST_GRASP_STATE, INTERRUPTED (CPU guard / admin / safety stop), scene not settled

policy_selection.choose: lowest measured mean CPU-s/query (real 12-worker runs) among passing policies; adaptive_v1 preferred if within 1.15x of it
policy_selection.ci: Wilson 95% (reported for every stratum; never used as a pass threshold; 0 observed misses is not zero risk)
policy_selection.if_none_pass: MOCK_V2_FAIL for policy selection (report; do not relax)
policy_selection.paired: per query, reference label in {0,1}; candidate misses = reference 1 & candidate 0

reference.meaning: finite reference recall: every valid unit x every eligible branch at 5000 RRT iterations; NOT physical truth

registered_as: a NEW rule registered before any V2 teacher call; the V1 rule (mock_v1/configs/selection_rule.json) and its literal choice fixed_4x1500 stay on record unchanged.  Reason for the new rule: V1 evaluated policies on a 40-query subset with < 10 far reference positives, while the broad V1 pilot showed fixed_4x1500 missing 6/45 far positives.

teacher.branch_semantics: unit = one ranked VALID pose with >= 1 physically held eligible branch; inside a unit test every eligible branch is tried in candidate order (hold certificate -> plan_branch -> re-instantiated hold -> execute -> verify) until one verifies (early-stop policies) or all are exhausted (reference); the carry route is branch-independent and planned once per unit test; a route ReachError ends the unit for every branch
teacher.check_width: grasp open_width in every object check (SHELF66V3); structure check as source (default finger qpos)
teacher.ik_candidates: solved at the pose rounded to the source cache key (1e-4 m), cache shared per object set
teacher.mode_order: policy3d.ranked: k-th azimuth nearest the robot, grip height alternating, then the other heights; IK branches nearest q_ready
teacher.name: SHELF66V3_PLACE_V2
teacher.witness_policy: every distinct VERIFIED (unit, branch) trajectory encountered is stored with its rank / grasp / branch provenance
